name: zt_finding_context
title: Zero trust finding context
description: The newest zero trust finding group since the last reset: finding id, time, entity (namespace/workload), total risk, the contributing detections and their scores, threat objects, MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, and the pod, node, destination store, port and program behind it. Call it first. workload is namespace/name such as build-farm/ci-runner, or * when you do not know it yet.

workload.description: Entity as namespace/name, for example build-farm/ci-runner, or * for the newest finding of any workload
